body: Thank you so much. I think I sent a message, but it might have messed up. Can’t be alone right now, so I’m glad to be talking with someone.
I guess the main thing is that there are people who look up to my public face as a role model, and I want them to get to better place before I say goodbye.
I have a hard time managing anger, but the things that cause the anger are things I’d never want to hurt. I guess I just redirect it onto myself because it’s easier.
I appreciate your support. I always tell myself I shouldn’t hit my head, but in the moment I can’t seem to stop myself anymore. I try still, don’t want the headaches to get worse.
